facts: Parties: Quayside Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Brightwater Analytics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Redcliffe Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 20 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 15 February 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 9.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 25% of the Purchase Price, being $37,000,000. The Purchase Price is $185,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Netherby Capital LLP.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
